# ARC-1 documentation

> Use the documentation from the source revision used to build the deployed artifact.
> The link below follows main and may describe unreleased changes.

## SAP BTP setup and administration

- [BTP Start Here](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arc-mcp/arc-1/main/docs_page/btp-overview.md): choose the topology, then follow its deployment or administration links. In a local checkout, read docs_page/btp-overview.md instead.

Use the same revision for linked guides and examples. Research and plans are not shipped settings.
Ask for missing landscape inputs, not passwords, tokens, private keys or raw service bindings.
